name: wraps-email
description: Send email through your own Amazon SES account, and check domains, suppressions and sandbox status.
long_description: Works with any Amazon SES account: send email, check domain verification and DKIM, look up the suppression list, and see whether the account is still in the SES sandbox. With a Wraps email stack deployed, it also reads send history and delivery events. Your AWS credentials are read locally and never transmitted to Wraps.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Region your Wraps stack is deployed in. SES identities are per-region. Optional if your AWS profile already supplies one.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: AWS profile to use. Credentials are read locally and never leave your machine.

wraps_api_key.title: Wraps API key
wraps_api_key.description: Optional. Enables the Wraps platform tools (contacts, broadcasts, workflows, inbound, brand kits and more). Create one in the Wraps dashboard.

wraps_org_id.title: Wraps organization id
wraps_org_id.description: Optional. Only needed with a CLI session that belongs to several organizations.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a transactional email via your AWS SES account.

tools.name: list_recent_sends
tools.description: List recently sent emails from your Wraps email history, newest first, at most `limit` messages.

tools.name: get_email_event_log
tools.description: Get the full delivery event log for a specific email by its messageId.

tools.name: verify_domain_status
tools.description: Check the verification and DKIM status of a sending domain in your AWS SES account.

tools.name: list_suppressions
tools.description: List addresses on your AWS SES account-level suppression list, or check a single address with `email`.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Check this AWS SES account's sandbox status and get a recommended next action for getting a first send out.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the monthly cost of sending email with Wraps + AWS: the flat Wraps plan fee and an itemized AWS bill (SES, EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, DynamoDB, dedicated IP, WAF).

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in your Wraps organization, optionally filtered by email status, SMS status, preferred channel, or a search string on email or phone.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact in full, including its topic subscriptions.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create one new contact.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Change one existing contact.

tools.name: set_contact_topics
tools.description: REPLACE the full topic subscription list of one contact.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Permanently delete ONE contact by UUID, email, or externalId.

tools.name: validate_contact_emails
tools.description: Check up to 100 email addresses with SES Email Address Insights and return a deliverability verdict (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or UNKNOWN) for each.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List the audience segments saved in this Wraps organization, with each segment's live member count.

tools.name: get_segment
tools.description: Get one audience segment by id, including its full filter condition and live member count.

tools.name: preview_segment
tools.description: Preview the audience an unsaved filter condition would reach, without saving a segment.

tools.name: create_segment
tools.description: Save a new audience segment from a filter condition.

tools.name: update_segment
tools.description: Change an existing audience segment: rename it, edit its description, replace its condition, or toggle trackMembership.

tools.name: delete_segment
tools.description: Permanently delete an audience segment.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the organization's subscription topics with live audience counts: subscriberCount (opted in), sendableCount (a broadcast would reach now) and pendingCount (waiting on double opt-in).

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Get one subscription topic by id, with its audience counts (subscriberCount, sendableCount, pendingCount) and its creator.

tools.name: list_topic_subscribers
tools.description: List the contacts subscribed to one topic, filtered by status (subscribed, pending for double opt-in not yet confirmed, or unsubscribed).

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Create a subscription topic that contacts can subscribe to and broadcasts can target.

tools.name: update_topic
tools.description: Change a subscription topic's name, slug, description, public flag or double opt-in setting.

tools.name: delete_topic
tools.description: Permanently delete a subscription topic and every subscription to it.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the Wraps email and SMS templates in your organization.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get one Wraps template by id: its metadata, status, variables, and by default its React Email source, compiled HTML, and compiled text.

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a new Wraps email or SMS template as a DRAFT.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Change an existing Wraps template.

tools.name: duplicate_template
tools.description: Copy an existing Wraps template to start a variant.

tools.name: publish_template
tools.description: Publish a Wraps template to SES, so sends and workflows that use it get this content.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts (email or SMS batch sends) for your organization, with their status and delivery counts.

tools.name: get_broadcast
tools.description: Get the status and delivery counts of ONE broadcast by id.

tools.name: list_broadcast_recipients
tools.description: List the per-recipient outcome of one broadcast: who was sent to, and whether each send was delivered, bounced, suppressed or failed, with the error reason.

tools.name: get_broadcast_clicks
tools.description: Get the link-click breakdown for ONE broadcast: which URLs were clicked and how often, plus the unsubscribe click count.

tools.name: update_broadcast
tools.description: Edit a DRAFT or a SCHEDULED broadcast: its content, sender, audience, template, AWS account or send time.

tools.name: duplicate_broadcast
tools.description: Copy an existing broadcast into a NEW draft, whatever the status of the original.

tools.name: send_broadcast
tools.description: Send a DRAFT broadcast to its audience, now or at scheduledFor.

tools.name: resume_broadcast
tools.description: Resume an email broadcast that stopped part-way, from the last chunk it finished, so recipients who were not yet sent to get the message.

tools.name: cancel_broadcast
tools.description: Cancel a broadcast that is scheduled, queued or processing, so the messages that have not gone out yet are not sent.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List custom events tracked for this Wraps organization, newest first, optionally filtered by event name, contact, text search, or date range.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one custom event by id: its name, properties, time, and the contact it belongs to.

tools.name: get_event_analytics
tools.description: Get custom-event totals for this organization over the last 7 or 30 days: events in the period, active contacts, average events per contact, a zero-filled daily series, and the top event names.

tools.name: list_event_names
tools.description: List every distinct custom event name recorded for this Wraps organization, sorted.

tools.name: track_event
tools.description: Record a custom event for one contact.

tools.name: remove_suppression
tools.description: Remove one address from the SES account-level suppression list of one AWS account, so Wraps sends to it again.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List the email and SMS automation workflows in your Wraps organization, newest first, with status and execution counts.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Get one workflow by id, including its trigger config, steps and transitions, so you can see what it does before triggering it or changing its schedule.

tools.name: list_workflow_executions
tools.description: List the executions of one workflow (one run per contact), newest first, each with its contact and status.

tools.name: get_workflow_execution
tools.description: Get one workflow execution by id, with its step trace (every step it reached and that step status), its contact, the workflow name and per-step engagement.

tools.name: enable_workflow_schedule
tools.description: Turn on the recurring schedule of a schedule-triggered workflow by creating its next one-time run from a cron expression and timezone.

tools.name: disable_workflow_schedule
tools.description: Turn off the recurring schedule of a schedule-triggered workflow by deleting its pending scheduled run.

tools.name: trigger_workflow
tools.description: Start one run of an API-triggered workflow for one contact, so the workflow steps begin for that contact now.

tools.name: retry_workflow_execution
tools.description: Retry a failed workflow execution from the step where it failed.

tools.name: cancel_workflow_execution
tools.description: Cancel a workflow execution that is still running (pending, active, paused or waiting), so no further steps run for that contact and its scheduled steps are removed.

tools.name: list_agent_approvals
tools.description: List the approval queue for agents: the sends that an agent asked to make and that were held for a human decision.

tools.name: approve_agent_approval
tools.description: Approve one send that an agent asked to make and that was held for a human decision, so Wraps sends it now.

tools.name: reject_agent_approval
tools.description: Reject one send that an agent asked to make and that was held for a human decision, so it is never delivered.

tools.name: get_email_metrics
tools.description: Get aggregate email sending metrics for this organization over a time window: sent, delivered, bounced (split into permanent, transient and undetermined), complained, suppressed, opened, clicked, failed, and an estimated costUsd.

tools.name: list_inbound_emails
tools.description: List one page of parsed inbound emails that the customer's SES inbound bucket received, across the organization's connected AWS accounts.

tools.name: get_inbound_email
tools.description: Get one parsed inbound email from the customer's SES inbound bucket by emailId, with its from/to/cc, subject, date, headers, text body, HTML body and attachment metadata.

tools.name: list_brand_kits
tools.description: List the organization's brand kits: name, logo, colors, fonts, button style, company details and social links, with isDefault marking the one default kit.

tools.name: get_brand_kit
tools.description: Get one brand kit by id: logo, colors, fonts, button style, company details, social links, and isDefault.

tools.name: create_brand_kit
tools.description: Create a brand kit: a name, logo, colors, fonts, button style, company details and social links that email templates can use.

tools.name: update_brand_kit
tools.description: Change one or more fields of a brand kit: name, logo, colors, fonts, button style, company details, social links.

tools.name: set_default_brand_kit
tools.description: Make one brand kit the default for the organization.

tools.name: delete_brand_kit
tools.description: Delete a brand kit permanently.

tools.name: create_broadcast
tools.description: Create a NEW broadcast as a draft.
